decisions_recap: Reused insertHighlight() (task 006/007) rather than adding a differently-named repository function.
Slug order = reading-order rank (y then x) among the page's existing highlights, not insertion order, so re-importing a document dedupes (spec 5.6).

Architecture correction: page+highlight composition moved from features/document into features/highlight (the context that owns 'layers' per the blueprint), with document-viewer gaining a renderPage injection slot instead of a forbidden features/document -> features/highlight import (I3).
Highlight fill colour resolves the design system's --highlight-yellow token at the highlight context boundary (Konva doesn't inherit CSS variables); no per-highlight colour semantics exist yet.
Added a reusable jsdom canvas-2D stub (vitest.setup.ts, no new dependency) after discovering even a bare Konva.Rect construction needs a real canvas context that jsdom doesn't provide.
follow_up_tasks: Wire DocumentViewer + HighlightedPage into an actual app route (src/app/w/[workspaceId]/...) -- task 009 already left DocumentViewer unmounted, and this task adds HighlightedPage in the same unmounted state. Whichever task first ships the real workspace document view should compose them via document-viewer's renderPage prop.
A Storybook/Chrome story exercising a real pdfjs + Konva render of a captured highlight, since jsdom cannot run that path (mirrors task 009's own open follow-up).

Highlight colour semantics (individual vs shared vs per-author) are undefined; 012/013 will likely need to assign one, at which point the single hard-coded --highlight-yellow default in highlighted-page should become a real mapping.
